wire.operator_setup.prompt.confirm_phone: Local Operator needs your approval to confirm a phone on this computer.
wire.operator_setup.prompt.remove_phone: Local Operator needs your approval to remove a phone from this computer.
wire.operator_setup.prompt.phone_approva: Local Operator needs your approval to turn on phone approvals on this computer.
wire.operator_setup.title.confirm_phone: Confirm this phone on this computer
wire.operator_setup.title.remove_phone: Remove this phone from this computer
wire.operator_setup.body.phone_approvals: Let phones approve requests on this computer.
wire.operator_setup.refused.privileged: Local Operator is running with administrator rights, so it can't ask you in person. Nothing was changed. Restart Local Operator under your usual account, then try again.
wire.operator_setup.refused.no_password_: This computer can't show a password prompt, so approvals can't be turned on from here.
wire.operator_setup.refused.cannot_insta: This computer has no protected place for the approval key, so approvals can't be turned on from here.
wire.operator_setup.refused.in_progress: Phone approvals setup is already running. Answer the password prompt, or wait for it to finish.
wire.operator_setup.refused.key_failed: This computer couldn't create its approval key, so approvals weren't turned on. Try again.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.cancelled: You cancelled the password prompt, so approvals weren't turned on. Try again when you're ready.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.failed: The password prompt didn't finish, so approvals weren't turned on. Try again.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.not_verified: The approval key was installed, but this computer can't use it yet, so approvals aren't on. Try again.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.on: Phone approvals are on. Each new phone will still ask for your computer's password once.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.already_on: Phone approvals are already on for this computer.
wire.operator_setup.outcome.file_only: Approvals here won't ask for a fingerprint or password.
wire.operator_setup.tui.usage: Use /mobile approvals on to let phones approve requests on this computer.
wire.operator_setup.tui.anchor_clause: ; but phone approvals aren't turned on for this computer yet, so neither can run until they are. Turn them on in Settings → Phone access, or with /mobile approvals on in the terminal app
